features: Initialize Laravel 13 application framework
Install FilamentPHP v5
Install simplesoftwareio/simple-qrcode for QR Code support
Install barryvdh/laravel-dompdf for PDF Manifest rendering
Install pestphp/pest with laravel plugin for Pest Testing Framework
Install laravel/pint for code formatting
Configure environment variables in .env and .env.example
Set up database configuration (PostgreSQL/MySQL)
Configure cache, sessions, and queue connections
Implement Guardrail 1: High-precision decimals for financial fields
Implement Guardrail 2: Try-catch for firstOrCreate in InventoryService::recordMovement
Implement Guardrail 3: Eloquent observer for TransferRequisition soft-deletes
Implement Guardrail 4: Dynamic variant ID resolution in dispatchTransfer and scanToReceive
Implement Guardrail 5: Validation for positive quantities in lockStockForRequisition and dispatchTransfer
Implement Guardrail 6: Handle omitted items in scanToReceive (treat missing as zero qty)
Implement Guardrail 7: Custom signed route verification logic with Filament warning
Implement Guardrail 8: Cache widget sum calculations with 5-minute TTL
Implement Guardrail 10: CI/CD database isolation (in-memory SQLite for unit tests)
Run ./vendor/bin/pint for code formatting
Verify Filament admin console loads at http://localhost:8000/admin
Run ./vendor/bin/pest for test suite execution
